title: DashboardChartDescriptor
markdownDescription: AI guidance: use chart visualizations for grouped aggregations. `xAxis.property` is the grouping property. `yAxis` contains one or more aggregations. Use `count` without a property; use `sum`, `average`, `min`, or `max` with a numeric/date property. Use `dateGrouping` when xAxis is date/datetime.

chartType.description: Chart renderer type: bar, line, pie, or donut.

property.description: Property name to group by on the X-axis. Must exist on the visualization entity.

useForeignDisplay.description: Show the FK display property instead of the raw id when xAxis.property is a foreign key.

dateGrouping.description: Grouping interval for date/datetime properties. Omit or use empty string for no date grouping.

property.description: Property name for sum/average/min/max/percent aggregations. Omit for count.

label.description: Display label for this series. Omit to derive from aggregation/property.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of grouped items to display in the chart.
